title: Verify: Store changes for the secret door and inventory reach every SceneObject
summary: Unit test for store to scene sync
description: BootScene with fake objects; real useGameStore.

steps.action: Reuse mocks and afterEach cleanup from bootSceneSync.test.ts with two fake objects. Seed the store with createInitialState, call boot.create(). Set state {...first, flags:{secret_door_open:true}} and assert both fakes' sync last called with it; set state {...first, inventory:['key']} and assert sync last called with it; set state null and assert sync call count is unchanged.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/bootSceneStoreToScene.test.ts
steps.expected: Both objects synced on flag and inventory changes, none on null
